opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up its indicators on World Bank Open Data and its Wikipedia article, then write a 'macro snapshot' email (GDP, growth, population, capital, currency) to a recipient.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data home and close any pop-up
Type the country name in 'Search data e.g. GDP, population, Indonesia', pick the country suggestion, press Enter
Read GDP (current US$), GDP growth and total population from the country page
Search Wikipedia for the country and open the article; read capital and currency
Open mail compose; type the recipient in 'To'
Type 'Hi <name>, <Country>: GDP US$<gdp> (<year>), growth <growth>%, population <pop> (<year>); capital <capital>, currency <currency> (<code>).' in 'Body'
Send the draft (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: country=Kenya; to=olivia@example.com; GDP US$135.94B, growth 4.6%, pop 57,532,493, Nairobi, KES
country=Vietnam (World Bank lists it as 'Viet Nam'); to=raj@example.com; GDP US$514.7B, growth 8.0%, pop 101,598,527, Hanoi, VND

opportunities.name: Log a read book with author details
opportunities.description: Search Project Gutenberg for a book title, open the top result to get its release date and download count, look up the author's lifespan on Wikipedia, then add a 'Read:' note.
steps: On Project Gutenberg, type the book title in 'Quick search' and press Enter
Read the author, release date and download count from the book page
Search Wikipedia for the author and open the article; read birth and death years
In the Notes app, click 'New note'
Type 'Read: <Title> by <Author> (<birth>-<death>), Gutenberg since <release date>, <downloads> downloads' and press Enter

instances.values: Pride and Prejudice; Jane Austen (1775-1817); Jun 1, 1998; 192356 downloads
Moby Dick; Herman Melville (1819-1891); Jul 1, 2001; 165043 downloads (searched 'Ulysses' first, then switched)
The Count of Monte Cristo; Alexandre Dumas (1802-1870); Jan 1, 1998; 53017 downloads
